material_dirty_field.operation: CanvasUpdate.PreRender calls OnPreRenderObject, reads byte 0x140, calls UpdateMaterial when set, then clears byte 0x140; matches the engine baseline m_isMaterialDirty branch.

observations.font_material: DoSetup resets fontSharedMaterial to font.material before CanRender and both mesh updates.
observations.normalized_effect: pointSize / fontSize / atlasPadding; Clamp01 each original width/distance/blur; X=-cos(angle)*distance, Y=-sin(angle)*distance.
observations.font_dirty: Original direct TMP_Text field 0x140 is m_isMaterialDirty, not m_havePropertiesChanged (0x370).
observations.material_pool: Shader.GetHashCode -> reference material; CopyPropertiesFromMaterial -> effect callback -> ComputeCRC cast to Int32 -> shader/CRC pool and reference count.
observations.release: OnEnable/OnDisable/OnValidate/SetupEffect/SetGray/RealtimeUpdate release first. Last pool reference destroys its effect; last entry also destroys shader reference material.
observations.autosize: TEXT_CHANGED_EVENT -> TMP_Text with enableAutoSizing -> effect ID/font size -> outline or underlay -> update tracked size -> release -> virtual DoSetup(true).
